'''Mary Fortune''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned on the [[Epsilon Program]] website.[http://www.rockstargames.com/epsilonprogram/testimonials.htm]

==Character history==
Mary Fortune is, in [[1992]], a resident of [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]], who turned to the Epsilom Program to help her. Mary, from her testimony, appears to have become a prostitute since turning to the Epsilon Program, as she states:

{{quote|"At first, I was nervous about giving up my identity and sleeping with all of those men, but I really enjoy it now" [http://www.rockstargames.com/epsilonprogram/testimonials.htm]}}

==Source==
* [http://www.rockstargames.com/epsilonprogram/testimonials.htm Epsilon Program Testimonials page]
